description.content:
The Strimzi Kafka Bridge provides an HTTP/REST interface to Apache Kafka. It allows HTTP clients to produce and consume messages, manage consumer group subscriptions, and query topic metadata without needing a native Kafka client library. The Bridge acts as a protocol translator between HTTP and the Kafka protocol. Deploy via the KafkaBridge custom resource.
